name: Hampton city, VA
findings: Hampton city has 472 nonprofit organizations. 186 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 150 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Hampton city has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 42 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 42 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Hampton city list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Few education organizations list membership
observations.text: 3 education organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 7 would.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through education groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Community organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 7 community organizations here list public events, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.
